text: Cecil County Public Schools listed Casey McQuiston's Red, White, and Royal Blue for removal from its media center collections on October 12, 2022. The Rockingham County School Board later voted to remove it from school libraries after Superintendent Dr. Larry Shifflett said it contained sexually explicit content as defined in RCPS Policy IIABA.
